headline: 6 Ethereum contracts catalogued from docs, Etherscan name-tag search, and dapp repo; MintingHub V2 and PositionFactory mainnet addresses not pinned from fetched sources.

findings.text: D1: Etherscan name-tag search surfaced deployer EOA 0x7a787023 (V1-era Frankencoin contract), ZCHF token 0xB58E61C3, FPS/Equity token 0x1bA26788, SavingsVault 0xE5F13025, and high-balance contract 0xb323692b (~$14M, likely MintingHub V2). The deployer 0x7a787023 is tagged 'Frankencoin: Deployer' on Etherscan and contains V1 contract code.

D2: docs.frankencoin.com confirmed ZCHF=0xB58E61C3098d85632Df34EecfB899A1Ed80921cB and FPS=0x1bA26788dfDe592fec8bcb0Eaff472a42BE341B2 on Ethereum mainnet. No dedicated /deployment page was reachable — the docs overview page contained the only explicit address references found. deployed_contracts_doc set to docs.frankencoin.com overview.

D3: Audit links were not fetched in this run (PDFs at github.com/Frankencoin-ZCHF/Frankencoin/audits). Audit firms confirmed from website fetch: ChainSecurity (Audit 1 V1, Audit 2 V2024, Audit 3 CCIP bridge), BlockBite (V1), Code4rena (2023-04), Decurity (2024). In-scope addresses from PDFs not extracted this run — recorded in unknowns.

D4: GitHub org page (github.com/Frankencoin-ZCHF) fetched via search result. The frankencoin-dapp repo search snippet showed testnet (ethereum3, chain id 1337) addresses only — no mainnet deployment artifacts were directly confirmed from fetched GitHub content. PositionFactory and MintingHub mainnet addresses not pinned from D4.

D5: Protocol is listed as Ethereum-only in this run's per-protocol context. Website states ZCHF deployed on 8 blockchains but the core CDP system (MintingHub, positions) is Ethereum mainnet only. Bridge contracts (CCIP) link to other chains but are not in scope for this Ethereum-only run. No multi-chain enumeration required per protocol.chains=[Ethereum].

D6: MintingHub factory (0xb323692b, tentative) not confirmed by name from a fetched source — read-API surfacer calls to enumerate child positions were not performed this run. Cap notice: Frankencoin positions are user-created CDPs; downstream slices should fetch allPositions or enumerate via MintingHub events.

D7: Role taxonomy applied: ZCHF=token, FPS/Equity=token+governance, SavingsVault=vault, 0xb323692b=factory (tentative MintingHub), deployer EOA=other. Actor classes: ZCHF and FPS are immutable per docs ('not upgradable'), deployer is EOA.

D8: All admin_addresses[] entries trace to ≥1 fetched or search-result URL. 0xb323692b cited from Etherscan search snippet (balance+tx count visible); role labelled tentative. svZCHF vault 0xE5F13025 cited from Etherscan token tracker search snippet.

rationale.verdict: Walked frankencoin.com (fetched), docs.frankencoin.com (fetched), and Etherscan via search grounding. Two core token addresses confirmed from docs; deployer EOA, FPS/Equity, and SavingsVault confirmed from Etherscan. MintingHub V2 mainnet address tentatively identified (0xb323692b) but not confirmed by name-tag from a fetched source — placed in admin_addresses with role 'factory (tentative MintingHub)'. Audit PDFs not opened; PositionFactory address not pinned. grade=unknown due to incomplete on-chain reads and unconfirmed factory address.

evidence.shows: Official website confirming ZCHF token address 0xB58E61C3098d85632Df34EecfB899A1Ed80921cB on Ethereum (linked in FAQ section), bug bounty program at Compass Security, auditors (ChainSecurity, BlockBite, Code4rena, Decurity), and Frankencoin Association as Swiss non-profit that does not control the protocol.

Docs confirm ZCHF=0xB58E61C3098d85632Df34EecfB899A1Ed80921cB and FPS=0x1bA26788dfDe592fec8bcb0Eaff472a42BE341B2 on Ethereum mainnet. States system is not upgradable. Describes architecture: Frankencoin token, Equity (FPS) contract, MintingHub, and minter plugins.
Etherscan page tagged 'Frankencoin: Deployer' — EOA that deployed V1 Frankencoin contracts, 4 total transactions. Contains V1 Frankencoin and Equity source code.
V2 ZCHF token contract on Ethereum. Contract source confirms immutable design (not upgradeable), minter plugin mapping, and Equity reserve set at construction.
FPS Equity contract on Ethereum. Constructor arg confirms it is linked to ZCHF 0xB58E61C3098d85632Df34EecfB899A1Ed80921cB. Holds the protocol reserve pool. Governance token (veto-based).
SavingsVault ZCHF (svZCHF) ERC-20 token on Ethereum mainnet, Etherscan token tracker confirms contract at 0xE5F130253fF137f9917C0107659A4c5262abf6b0.
High-balance (~$14M) contract with 8,740 transactions as of Jun 2026. Likely MintingHub V2 based on activity profile. Role tentative — not confirmed by contract name tag from a fetched source.

protocol_metadata.about: Frankencoin (ZCHF) is a decentralized collateralized debt position (CDP) stablecoin that tracks the Swiss franc 1:1, deployed on Ethereum mainnet. Users deposit crypto assets (e.g. ETH, WBTC) as collateral to mint ZCHF; collateral is locked until the debt is repaid. The protocol uses a novel oracle-free liquidation mechanism based on on-chain Dutch auctions rather than external price feeds. Governance is veto-based: Frankencoin Pool Share (FPS) holders can block new minter plugins if 2% of voting power objects, with FPS also serving as the equity reserve absorbing liquidation shortfalls.
